title: CodecFile
description: A file of stateless codec cases (TV-001…TV-003).

provenance_note.description:
Derivation or cross-check details; required unless provenance is `blue-book-example`
or `fuzz-regression` (checked by `xtask vectors validate`).

standard.description: CCSDS document(s) and clause(s) the cases exercise.

input_hex.description: Input octets as upper- or lower-case hex without separators.

operation.description: Operation name, interpreted by the crate's test handler.

params.description: Operation parameters that are not configuration.

superseded.description: Present when this released case has been replaced.

CodecKind.description: Value of the `kind` field of a codec vector file.

Expect.description:
Expected outcome of a codec case.

When `ok` is true, every other key is an expected output value and the handler's output
must match them **exactly**: no missing and no extra keys (TV-002, TV-012). When `ok` is
false, `error` names the expected error kind from the catalogue (03-api-model.md §9).

error.description: Expected error kind when `ok` is false.

Mode.description: Decoding mode of a codec case (API-030).

oneOf.description: Reject any deviation from the standard (default).
Accept reserved-field deviations and report anomalies.

Provenance.description: Where a vector file's expected values come from (TV-020).

oneOf.description: Example printed in a CCSDS Blue Book.
Derived by hand from the standard; `provenance_note` explains the derivation.
Agreed with an independent implementation named in `provenance_note`.

Superseded.description: Marks a released case as replaced or retired; released cases are never edited (TV-021).

by.description:
Identifier of the replacing case, if there is one. When present it must name an
existing case that is not itself superseded; a wrong case with no correct replacement
leaves it out.

reason.description: Why the case was superseded; required and not empty.
